name: Los Carneros
terms: American Viticultural Area. A wine labeled with one must take at least 85% of its grapes from that area.

notes: Carneros Pinot Noir is known for crisp acidity, tight structure and spicy berry fruit.
Older clones give lighter, more elegant wines with earthy notes, while newer French clones give more alcohol, concentration and black fruit.
Cool marine air from San Pablo Bay shapes the style, and long seasons bring intense, vivid flavors.

blurb.text: An AVA across southern Sonoma and Napa counties just north of San Pablo Bay, also called Carneros. Fog and breezes from the bay make it cooler than regions farther north in both valleys, suiting cool climate varieties.
